deploy-bot: Started image build and push for inference-runtime v3.4.1 (tag: v3.4.1-rc2, sha: 9f3c2b1) -> registry.redwood-inference.internal/inference-runtime:v3.4.1-rc2
ci-bot: Build finished, starting registry upload. layers=12 size=1.2GB
ci-bot: Pushing manifest -> sha256:abcd1234...
ci-bot: ERROR: upload failed: 504 Gateway Timeout from registry (chunk upload)
olivia: seeing the 504 too, looks like the registry got a transient spike. Any auto-retry configured?
sanjay: our push code does exponential backoff x3, we retried once already. logs: `PUT /v2/inference-runtime/blobs/uploads/... 504`
anya: can we fallback to mirror (ghcr) while registry recovers? that's the easiest for canary
ci-bot: mirror fallback attempt -> ghcr.io/redwood/inference-runtime:v3.4.1-rc2 - push ok
deploy-bot: Canary publish blocked: primary registry push failed; mirror available. policy: require primary registry success for prod rollouts unless opt-in.
olivia: hmm. For staging canary we can accept mirror, but for prod we should pin to last-good image until registry is healthy.
sanjay: agree. current last-good: inference-runtime:v3.4.0 (sha: 7b2a9f0). Should we pin canary to that for the scheduled deploy window?
nate: I'm leaning to pin and open a rollback/hold if prod deploy was in flight. Do we have in-flight prod deploys?
anya: no prod deploy started yet. This was the image publish step before a prod canary tomorrow during change window.
ci-bot: Registry incident ticket created: REG-2026-411. Notifying eng-infra.
olivia: plan: 1) pin deploy config to v3.4.0 for prod canary, 2) allow staging to use ghcr mirror for QA, 3) retry primary push next hour and re-evaluate. Agree? :small_blue_diamond:
sanjay: +1. I'll file the pin PR and add a note in the release notes draft.
anya: add a flag in the deploy config so we can force primary-only in future windows.
nate: also add alert to console: if primary push fails >2 attempts, change window auto-hold. saves manual work.
deploy-bot: Action items logged: [PIN-PR-1023] pin prod canary -> v3.4.0, [REG-2026-411] registry incident, [MIRROR-ALLOW-101] allow mirror for staging QA.
olivia: quick snippet for pin PR description: `Pin inference-runtime prod canary to v3.4.0 due to primary registry push failure for v3.4.1-rc2 (504). Will retry push and lift pin when primary is healthy.`
sanjay: leaving a short rollback note in the release tracker: `If primary registry recovers and v3.4.1-rc2 pushes successfully, update canary to rc2 and remove pin. If additional failures, escalate to eng-infra and consider rolling back to v3.3.x.`
ci-bot: Retry scheduled in 1h (attempt 2/3) for primary registry upload.
nate: thumbs on the plan. tagging @eng-infra in incidents channel.
anya: one more: update change window doc to mention registry health check step pre-publish. saves rework.
olivia: thanks all. I'll merge PIN-PR-1023 once CI green and post an update in this thread. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Canary pin applied to prod config (v3.4.0). Thread closed for now; reopen if push succeeds or reg incident escalates.
